quest.title: Time to Test the Asha Speedrun!
quest.description: The flagship attraction, "Asha Speedrun," is waiting for professional testers...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Gaun
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry, but we can't let you take that risk.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: But that's not what you said earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Gaun
dialogues.text: Our sincerest apologies. We may be pressed for time, but the safety of our visitors has to come first. We hope you understand.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME}! Perfect timing! Could you help me talk this gentleman around?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: They need someone for the testing, so I went over all my adventuring experience, made it clear I was willing to accept any risks... It was all going so well...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: But the minute I mentioned some of the close calls I've had in the past, he flat-out refused to let me take part.

dialogues.speaker: Gaun
dialogues.text: Sir, I appreciate your enthusiasm, I truly do.

dialogues.speaker: Gaun
dialogues.text: But if you, in your own words, have a tendency to fall into rivers even when you're crossing a bridge made of solid stone, it might be better to try something a little more... laid-back? Like, lounging on one of those beach chairs over there.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: *sigh* But... I really am an adventurer, and I'm qualified for the testing too! I've just... had some bad luck in the past, that's all...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I really want to help. You can count on me, I swear!

response.speaker: Gaun
response.text: Well, if the savior of Natlan says so... How about this — would it be alright if your Asha companion completed the first round of testing instead?

response.speaker: Gaun
response.text: You can watch from the sidelines, familiarize yourself with the route, and if everything goes smoothly, you can join the second round of testing.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Does that sound good to you, buddy?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Alright then! I'll leave it to you, partner!

talks.objective: Help the Asha reach the destination

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You did it! See, it wasn't that tricky after all.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Well done, buddy! You were quite the athlete out there! I was blown away!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's Bennett's turn next, right?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Yep! I've done my warm-up, finished my stretches, and I'm ready for action. Trust me, I've got this!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Be careful out there.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #Thanks for looking out for me, {NICKNAME}! But, don't worry, I will be!

talks.objective: Talk to Bennett and the Asha

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: You're saying... You'd be willing to lead the way and coach me through it?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: You're the best! Now, I feel even more confident than before. After you, Coach!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Go, Asha! Go, Bennett!

talks.objective: Follow the Asha to the destination

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Okay, just a little further. Stay calm...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Wait, what!? Where did the finish line go...?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh no, did I just jinx myself? Or use up all my luck? ...No, c'mon, I can't lose hope now.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: That's right, I can always follow my Asha buddy! Just gotta trust our connection...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Whew, my heart's racing so fast... Gotta take a while to catch my breath...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's give it up for Bennett and his Asha buddy! You guys make such a great team!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Especially the way you worked together at the end. Your special bond made all the difference!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You turned the tide of misfortune together.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: We sure did!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #I owe a big thanks to you in particular, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: If you hadn't believed in me and helped convince the staff, I never would have had the chance to even compete in the challenge, let alone face it alongside our Asha friend...

dialogues.speaker: Gaun
dialogues.text: Mr. Bennett, the final safety test has been completed, which means that Asha Speedrun is now officially ready to open. Your help was much appreciated!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Did you hear that, Asha? We did it!

dialogues.speaker: Gaun
dialogues.text: I'll remember your name, Mr. Bennett — the brave and kind-hearted adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I know this adventure isn't over yet, but just the idea of saying goodbye is getting harder and harder to bear...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Asha, I'm really gonna miss you.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hehe, hey... If anything, I should be the one doing the comforting here! As the leader of this Adventure Team, it's my job to look after you.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Huh, something must've gotten in my eyes out there... Getting a bit watery, haha... Got a bit of a lump in my throat too...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I'll have to ask Professor Venti how to express my feelings in moments like this. After all, he's the best poet I know...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tone-Deaf Bard would just say something like...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Speak from the heart.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It really means a lot to have you here by my side... Thank you, Asha.
